title: Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives
style: 分色机器人卡片流程图
description: LEGO is a repository-construction pipeline built on CodeFace, a library of reusable Code Primitives (Figure 1). CodeFace is built once by mining real repositories into component-level primitives; construction then proceeds per task over the primitives a request activates.
author: XLCYun

images.caption: From Code Primitives to complete repositories. Left: real-world repositories are mined into component-level Code Primitives, each carrying its interface, dependencies, tests, configuration, and documentation, and organized in CodeFace. Right: a user request activates the required primitives, which adapt themselves and exchange the requirements their changes impose, before the adapted implementations are edited into the repository and revised under execution feedback and diagnosis.
